items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive Sunday vs Lions as details finalized. Houston among teams in mix; no deal until after Sunday games.
items.why: Trade talks advanced; team comfortable enough to sit him while finalizing.
items.implication: No Week 5 production; destination TBD post-games impacts ROS.
items.opportunity: Full target/role bump for remaining ARI pass-catchers.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT (with Tank Bigsby, DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown) on Sunday FantasyFootball injuries board.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practice all week; confirmed on final board.
items.implication: No touches; PHI RB committee (Shipley/Pierce/Steele) elevated.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down share to backups; WR targets redistribute without Smith.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT on ETR Sunday injuries board.
items.why: Ankle; did not practice; Rapoport/Schefter confirm.
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; major BAL offense downgrade.
items.opportunity: Likely/Flowers/Andrews usage shifts under backup QB.

items.text: Breece Hall, Stefon Diggs, Quentin Johnston, Michael Pittman OUT (Pittman later IR).
items.why: Final board; Pittman foot to IR (min 4 games) per Schefter.
items.opportunity: Backups/handcuffs and remaining WRs (e.g. Wilson, Allen) surge.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr has 5 catches in 4 games. He wasn't a real factor in any Michael Wilson stuff. (Post-trade inactive news: Kia Kendrick Bourne szn.)
items.implication: Wilson already primary; Bourne and others next up in ARI.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty QUESTIONABLE; Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby per Rapoport as Jeanty deals with foot/ankle.
items.why: Foot and ankle; elevated handcuff signals risk.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT/limited, Hemby/committee gets work.
items.opportunity: Handcuff elevation; monitor snaps if active.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN (cleared, not on final report) alongside Daniels/Olave/Goedert.
items.why: Dropped from injury report; full-go comments.
items.implication: Expected full workload after Week 4 usage criticism.
items.opportunity: Clear lead back; projected well clear of Allgeier.

items.text: Jayden Daniels and Chris Olave listed IN (cleared); Daniels return confirmed by Rapoport.
items.why: Removed from report; Daniels elbow cleared.
items.implication: WAS offense full strength; NO WR1 active.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Justin Jefferson (with Addison) QUESTIONABLE; messy Q list overall flagged by Levitan. Chase full practice but concussion protocol; Jefferson GTD.
items.why: Final board; full practices but designations remain.
items.implication: Sunday morning decisions; CIN/MIN pass game volatility.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Gesicki/Meyers or Addison/others benefit.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love tough projection spot but not on final IR; fans/media dragged Week 4 usage may spur bigger role. Currently 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; gut says much better role this week while accounting for downside.
items.why: Cleared + public pressure on usage; maintenance only.
items.implication: Strong start/sit lean; lead back projection.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8 (volume/RZ + matchup); Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5 (workload + Bengals injury boost + soft run D). Also loves Michael Wilson, Christian Watson, Isaiah Likely.
items.why: Target/RZ volume + favorable matchups; Brown ties to CIN WR injuries.
items.implication: Strong Week 5 starts; Wilson further boosted by MHJ inactive.

items.text: Ladd McConkey, Zay Flowers, Terry McLaurin, Rhamondre Stevenson, Alvin Kamara among key QUESTIONABLE on board.
items.opportunity: Role expansion if any sit (e.g. Johnston already OUT helps LAC).

items.text: Hate saying negative on great players like Malik Nabers but fear sideways later: knee becomes real issue, can't shake shoulder, JJ McCarthy under center, coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) boomer it up. Stacked long-term risks.
items.why: Sore knee (missed practice), prior shoulder/frustration, QB/coaching variables.
items.implication: Monitor closely; short-term fine but ROS caution.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41, injury/matchup/role), Mark Andrews @ ATL (TE17), Cam Skattebo @ WSH (RB20), Tony Pollard vs HOU (RB28), Jalen Hurts vs JAX (QB15, rough stretch + line).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin/inefficient roles, usage data, Hurts environment.
